<script>
  (function () {
    var now = new Date();
    var d = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
    d.setDate(d.getDate() - ((d.getDay() + 6) % 7)); // mandag i inneværende uke
    var pad = function (n) { return (n < 10 ? "0" : "") + n; };
    var monday = d.getFullYear() + "-" + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + "-" + pad(d.getDate());
    var rows = document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-week-start="' + monday + '"]');
    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) { rows[i].classList.add("marked"); }
  })();
</script>
